mira: FYI I'm opening a small PR to add a local repro + tiny troubleshooting checklist for 429/timeouts when consumers hit context limits. Goal: short, copy-editable, and includes a Python SDK snippet + curl example.

sam: awesome — can you call out the recommended retry/backoff windows? ops wants explicit numbers.

mira: yea — planning to recommend exponential backoff starting at 200ms, max 5s, jittered. Also include guidance to detect context-eviction vs rate-limit: inspect headers + response body.

doc-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — draft. Tags: docs, err-ref, 429, timeout.

jordan: quick skim — pls add note about concurrent request limits on Dedicated vs Hosted. People confuse per-connection concurrency with account-wide token windows.

mira: good call. I'll add a short table (one-liner per target) and a link to the runtime capacity guide.

len: small nit: in the python snippet, we shouldn't recommend infinite retries. Add a max_attempts=3 example.

mira: updated in branch — added max_attempts=3 and an example of trimming context before retry. snippet:```
# simple retry with exponential backoff (python sdk pseudocode)
from time import sleep

max_attempts = 3
backoff = 0.2
for attempt in range(1, max_attempts+1):
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
    if resp.status == 200:
        break
    if resp.status == 429:
        # trim earliest messages, or fall back to a shorter model
        prompt = trim_history(prompt, keep_tokens=1024)
        sleep(backoff * (2 ** (attempt-1)))
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("unhandled error")
```

sam: perfect. Can we also include a curl example showing the Retry-After header check? Many integrators use curl as quick repro.

mira: added:```
# curl example
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"..."}'

# look for: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\n# header: Retry-After: 3
```

jordan: link fixes: the existing err-ref has an old link to the context-trimming guide. replace with /docs/runtime/context-trim-v2. Also add a short migration blurb: "If you relied on legacy prefix trimming, switch to KV-aware trim to preserve token efficiency."

mira: added migration blurb and updated the link. Also added a tiny example of using fallback policy: route to a quantized model variant when hitting latency or capacity limits.

len: one more: add an explicit example of detecting "stream interrupted" vs "request timed out" — folks copy-paste streaming examples and miss the difference.

mira: done — two short bullet points under "Streaming vs timeouts" and a code comment in the snippet.

sam: looks good. Who's reviewing? Would like a quick UX/wording pass before merging.

jordan: I can do copy + link sanity. Allocating 30m after lunch.

mira: thanks — assigning to @jordan. After merge, we should backport a condensed note into the public quickstart (one paragraph) so users see it earlier.

doc-bot: Reminder: run docs linter and link-checker prior to merge.

mira: ran locally, one broken anchor flagged — fixed it and pushed.

sam: :thumbsup: Merge when green. Also please add the PR number to the internal runbook index: docs/err-ref/index.md#recent-updates.

mira: will do. Closing the loop here — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 (includes local repro script, python + curl snippets, migration blurb, and link fixes).
